narrative.overview: Native Windows UI refined for practical, compact daily use. Shared tokens live in src/theme.rs. Persistent Heroes, Logs, and Settings navigation, a grouped automation toolbar, named champion tiles, independent priority scrolling, aligned settings categories, and a column-based activity log preserve the five existing themes and all handlers. Real cached champions are used in the isolated native captures under .hallmark/review/. The round-only topmost control remains a single draggable button.
keyCharacteristics: One Chinese UI font with a small heading, body, and metadata hierarchy.
Tonal background, panel, and control layers shared by five palettes.
Compact rectangular actions with rounded corners and visible focus outlines.
Portraits and ordered rows carry champion information.
A restrained native shell with three colored window controls.

rules.name: The Theme Roles Rule
rules.body: Resolve every normal surface, text, border, and state color through the selected palette in src/theme.rs. Fixed window controls retain their existing colors.

dos: **Do** preserve the feline icon, existing Chinese identity, and five named themes.
**Do** resolve native UI colors through the selected theme's established roles.
**Do** keep metadata subordinate through the smaller muted text role.
**Do** keep library selection and champion-details actions as separate controls.
**Do** retain a visible accent focus outline on custom focusable controls.
**Do** validate scrolling and control visibility at the native minimum size.
donts: **Don't** introduce a new visual metaphor or brand voice as an extraction fact.
**Don't** style the app from the embedded Haidou page or offline fixture portraits.
**Don't** invent shadows, motion tokens, or mobile breakpoints absent from the source.
**Don't** treat documentation previews as proof of native keyboard or accessibility behavior.
